parsedVerdict.reasoning: BookRoomService fits the application-service role. It loads aggregates through outbound ports (RoomRepository, GuestRepository, BookingRepository) and hands the business decisions to domain objects: room.fits for capacity, AvailabilityChecker.isAvailable for overlap, PriceCalculator.quote for the price and DateRange.parse for the stay dates. It then runs the side effects through ports (PaymentGateway.charge, BookingRepository.save, NotificationSender.send) and maps the result to a view DTO for the inbound port. It has no persistence code, no transport or framework code (no HTTP, SQL or ORM), and no pricing or availability rules of its own. The BookingError throws only turn domain results and missing lookups into use-case errors, which is a normal job for this layer. BookContextDto is a plain optional request-context type, which is acceptable here, although it is unused.
